sourceTitle: Short Bread With Almonds By Shobhana Mishra
sourceText:
Short Bread With Almonds By Shobhana Mishra
By: shobhana mishra
Published: Saturday, November 20, 2010 - 9:55am

Ingredients




1 cup all purpose flour
1/2 cup sugar
1 stick of butter
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 pinch baking powder
2 tablespoons milk

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400 degrees. 2 In a mixing bowl combine butter,sugar,vanilla extract and milk. 3 Beat it for 4 to 5 minutes till it becomes fulffy. 4 Add flour,baking powder and almonds. 5 Mix it well. 6 Drop the dough by rounded tablespoons onto baking sheet. 7 Bake it for 12-15 minutes. 8 Makes 24 short breads. 9 Calorie 80 each. 10 Enjoy with a cup of tea.
